messages.subject: Issue linking landmarks
parts:
Hello,

I was using the function define.links to link some landmarks, but I can't select the landmarks to link once the image appears. When I try to select a landmark, a message tells me there are no landmarks in 0.25 pixels. It seens as if all landmarks had been displaced down and to the left. I find some when trying to select something in random points of the image, but never the one I am trying to select. Could this be due to a mistake in my code? Or maybe am I using too many landmarks (40)?

Thank you in advance,

Mayte P.

messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Issue linking landmarks
parts:
Mayte,

 

I can reproduce the error, and will investigate.

 

In the meantime, one can create a links matrix rather easily by hand. It is a matrix with 2 columns, and each row has the landmark numbers for a link (e.g., ‘4 5’ means draw a link between landmarks 4 and 5).

 

An example is: plethodon$links

 

Dean

messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Issue linking landmarks
parts:
Mayte,

 

I believe I tracked down the problem; it is likely a ‘zoom’ issue in RStudio that causes issues with the ‘identify’ function from the graphics package that ‘define.links’ uses.

 

Try forcing your RStudio zoom to be 100%.  You can set the zoom of RStudio to 100% as:

 

Tools -> Global Options... -> Appearance -> Zoom: 100%

 

After this change, define.links worked fine on my machine.

 

Best,

 

Dean

 

For similar issues with other graphics functions se:

 

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/73256552/problem-with-point-location-with-locator-function-in-r/73782801#73782801
